title: SEC6: far-future now_unix bypasses backoff without clock mocking
description: The offline_delivery_and_retry test uses now2 = 1_000_000_000 (year ~2001, far ahead of the outbox row's next_attempt_at) to make the backed-off entry appear due on the second tick. This solves a real problem: the backoff delay is computed with jitter, so there is no portable way to predict the exact next_attempt_at value. The alternatives are (a) mock SystemTime, requiring a test-seam throughout outbox_tick, or (b) sleep for the backoff delay, making the test slow and flaky. The far-future now_unix requires zero additional code or indirection and is fully deterministic.
